text_elements.text: Calculate the average value of cell voltage by dividing 'TOTAL BATTERY VOLTAGE' by 96 (the number of cells).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Average cell voltage = 'TOTAL BETTER VOLTAGE' ÷ 96 (the number of cells)
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Identify the minimum cell voltage and the maximum cell voltage from 96 cells.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Calculate voltage according to the following expressions to compare voltage between A and B.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: A = Maximum cell voltage -Average cell voltage
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: B = Average cell voltage -Minimum cell voltage
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Which voltage is larger, A or B?
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: A >> Replace module including a cell of the maximum cell voltage. Refer to EVB-235, "FRONT MODULE  STACK  :  Exploded  View"  (Front  module  stack)  or  EVB-251,  "REAR  MODULE  STACK  : Exploded View" (Rear module stack). After replacing module, GO TO 3.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: B >> Replace module including a cell of the minimum cell voltage. Refer to EVB-235, "FRONT MODULE  STACK  :  Exploded  View"  (Front  module  stack)  or  EVB-251,  "REAR  MODULE  STACK  : Exploded View" (Rear module stack). After replacing module, GO TO 3.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Is 'MINIMUM CELL VOLTAGE' 3,712 mV or less?
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Set the vehicle, according to the following conditions.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check  'DATA  MONITOR'  and  let  the  Li-ion  battery  discharge  until  the  'MINIMUM  CELL  VOLTAGE' reaches 3,712 mV or less.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The guide line is to discharge until the Li-ion battery available charge gauge indicates 2 segments or less. For discharge time, refer to the following table.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Check that 'MINIMUM CELL VOLTAGE' is 3,712 mV or less. Touch 'START.'
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check to see if  a  cell  of  which  voltage  is  less  than  or  equal  to  'CELL  VOLTAGE  LOSS  JUDGMENT VALUE' is displayed.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: YES >> Record applicable cell No. and then GO TO 6.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Check the minimum cell voltage on the data monitor and replace a module which includes the minimum cell  voltage.  Refer  to  EVB-235,  "FRONT  MODULE  STACK  :  Exploded  View"  (Front module stack) or EVB-251, "REAR MODULE STACK : Exploded View" (Rear module stack).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: Disconnect high voltage circuit. Refer to GI-33, "How to Disconnect High Voltage".
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove battery pack upper case. Refer to EVB-203, "BATTERY PACK UPPER CASE : Exploded View".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace Li-ion battery. Refer to EVB-194, "Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check connection state, damage and dust of following;
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Check module voltage within determined cell at step 3 and check the divergence of the voltage and cell voltage with 'DATA MONITOR'.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: DANGER: When check module voltage, be careful not to short.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: YES-1 >> When the determined cell at step 3 is in front module stack.: GO TO 10.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: YES-2 >> When the determined cell at step 3 is in rear module stack.: GO TO 12.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace Li-ion battery controller. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: 10.CHECK HARNESS BETWEEN LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER AND MODULE HARNESS CONNEC-
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check the resistance Li-ion battery controller harness connector and bus bar of the determined cell at step 5.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check the divergence of the resistance and the resistance of other cell harness.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: YES >> Replace module within the determined cell at step 5.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Repair or replace harness or connectors.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The Li-ion battery controller transmits a relay control signal to the heater relay unit and turns ON/OFF the relay built-in the heater relay unit.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The heater relay unit turns ON/OFF the built-in relay, according to a relay control signal transmitted from the Li-ion battery controller, and transmits a relay status signal (the ON/OFF status of the built-in relay) to the Liion battery controller.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: CAUTION: Never  bring  the  vehicle  into  the  READY  status  with  the  service  plug  removed  unless  otherwise instructed in the Service Manual. A malfunction may occur if this is not observed.
text_elements.label: section_header
